description: Search Naver Map by keyword (optionally around a map area) or fetch specific places by URL/ID. Get business details, full menus with prices, weekly hours with breaks, photos, and visitor reviews.

category.description: Only keep places whose category contains this text (e.g. `한식`, `카페`, `Cafe`). Leave blank for all categories.
category.title: Category filter

emitUnchanged.description: In Monitoring mode, also emit places with `changeType: "UNCHANGED"` instead of skipping them.
emitUnchanged.title: Also emit unchanged places

hasBooking.description: Only keep places that support online booking/reservations through Naver.
hasBooking.title: Has online booking only

hasCoupon.description: Only keep places with an active coupon or promotion.
hasCoupon.title: Has coupon only

hasNpay.description: Only keep places that accept Naver Pay.
hasNpay.title: Accepts Naver Pay only

includeDetails.description: Fetch each place's detail page for full weekly hours (breaks, last order, upcoming closures), full menus with prices, facilities, parking, photos, review breakdown and more. Slower but much richer data.
includeDetails.title: Include place details

includeReviews.description: Emit real visitor reviews per place as separate `recordType: "review"` records (rating, text, dates, keywords, photos, owner replies). Uses Naver's cursor-paginated review API (50 per request) up to Max reviews per place; falls back to the ~20 reviews embedded on the public review page if that API is unavailable. Works in both modes.
includeReviews.title: Include visitor reviews

maxItems.description: Hard cap on total emitted place records across all keywords/URLs (review records are extra).
maxItems.title: Max items

maxResultsPerKeyword.description: Cap on places emitted per keyword (before filters). First page gives up to 100 places; deeper Naver pages add up to ~300 total per map center, and an area sweep multiplies that per center.
maxResultsPerKeyword.title: Max results per keyword

maxReviewsPerPlace.description: Cap on review records emitted per place when Include visitor reviews is on. Naver serves 50 reviews per request and does not expose a hard cap, so this can go high (e.g. 500); each 50 reviews costs one extra request.
maxReviewsPerPlace.title: Max reviews per place

menuKeyword.description: Only keep places whose menu names or descriptions contain this text (e.g. `피자`). Requires Include place details to be on. Leave blank for all menus.
menuKeyword.title: Menu keyword filter

minVisitorReviewCount.description: Only keep places with at least this many visitor reviews. Leave blank for no filter.
minVisitorReviewCount.title: Minimum visitor review count

minVisitorReviewScore.description: Only keep places with a visitor review score at or above this value (0-5). Leave blank for no filter.
minVisitorReviewScore.title: Minimum visitor review score

mode.description: What to fetch. `search` discovers places by keyword; `byUrls` fetches places you already know (URLs or place IDs).
enumTitles: Fetch specific places by URL or ID
mode.title: Mode

monitoringMode.description: Recurring-job mode: remembers each place between runs (in the Actor's key-value store) and emits only places that are new or whose name, category, address, phone, homepage, weekly hours, menus, or amenities changed. Adds `changeType` (NEW/UPDATED/UNCHANGED) and `changedFields` to each emitted place. Review counts and current open/closed status are ignored so runs are not billed for noise.
monitoringMode.title: Monitoring mode (only new/changed places)

monitoringStateKey.description: Optional name for the monitoring state (mode=monitoringMode). Leave blank to derive the key from the run inputs, so the same keywords/URLs always compare against the same memory.
monitoringStateKey.title: Monitoring state key

newlyOpened.description: Only keep places Naver marks as newly opened.
newlyOpened.title: Newly opened only

openNow.description: Only keep places currently marked as open by Naver Map.
openNow.title: Open now only

placeUrls.description: Naver Map places to fetch directly. Accepts full links (pcmap.place.naver.com, m.place.naver.com, map.naver.com/p/entry/place/...), `naver.me` short links, and bare numeric place IDs.
placeUrls.title: Place URLs or IDs (mode=byUrls)

searchCoordinates.description: Map center as `latitude,longitude`, e.g. `37.4979,127.0276` for Gangnam Station. Used to rank results around a point, for distance sorting, and as the center of an area sweep.
searchCoordinates.title: Search coordinates (mode=search)

searchKeywords.description: Keywords to search on Naver Map, e.g. `강남 맛집` (Gangnam restaurants) or `이태원 카페` (Itaewon cafes). Include a region name for local results. Naver returns up to 100 places per keyword from the first page and up to ~300 via deeper pages; add a map area (Search coordinates + Radius) or narrower keywords for more.
searchKeywords.title: Search keywords (mode=search)

searchRadiusKm.description: When set together with Search coordinates, the actor sweeps the whole circle (grid of map centers) instead of one center — this is how to collect more than Naver's ~300-per-keyword limit. Needs a broad keyword (e.g. `맛집`).
searchRadiusKm.title: Area radius in km (mode=search)

sortBy.description: How Naver orders search results. `distance` sorting needs Search coordinates.
sortBy.title: Sort order (mode=search)

takeout.description: Only keep places marked as offering takeout (포장).
takeout.title: Offers takeout only

wheelchairAccessible.description: Only keep places with a wheelchair-accessible entrance.
wheelchairAccessible.title: Wheelchair accessible only

title: Naver Map Scraper Input
